# Name Purpose

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](gmeow-NamePurpose.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NamePurpose>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The purpose/kind of a whole appellation (legal, birth, chosen, professional, deadname, …). A value, not a [`PersonName`](gmeow-PersonName.md) subclass; a person may simultaneously bear several co-equal names of different purposes.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](gmeow-NamePurpose.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the intrinsic kind of a whole appellation — referenced from an appellation via [`gmeow:namePurpose`](../properties/gmeow-namePurpose.md) to mark it legal, birth, chosen, professional, endonym, exonym, deadname, and so on.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a [`PersonName`](gmeow-PersonName.md) subclass per purpose (purposes are individuals, and a name may carry several at once) and avoid using purpose to rank names — endonym and exonym are co-equal, not preferred-vs-alternate.

### How to use

- Reference one or more seeded [`NamePurpose`](gmeow-NamePurpose.md) individuals from [`gmeow:namePurpose`](../properties/gmeow-namePurpose.md) on an appellation; extend with a new individual rather than a subclass, and pair a deadname purpose with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false for suppression.

### Examples

- ex:name [`gmeow:namePurpose`](../properties/gmeow-namePurpose.md) [`gmeow:namePurposeChosen`](../individuals/gmeow-namePurposeChosen.md), [`gmeow:namePurposeLegal`](../individuals/gmeow-namePurposeLegal.md).
